body:
WHAT
Before working on an open-ended request such as "build a game", the engine first asks the same main model whether the request needs shaping questions. If the model answers with strict JSON `{clarify:true, questions:[…]}`, up to three multiple-choice questions are put to the user through askUser and their answers are added to the first user message as requirements. Any error, malformed answer, or `clarify:false` means the turn simply starts.

WHY
Without it the agent guesses the genre, stack, or scope of a vague request and the user has to ask for a redo; without fail-open, a broken side-call would block every turn.

WHERE
engine/core/src/runtime/session.ts — Session.runTurn() gate `if (this.settings.clarify && !this.opts.child && namedAddon === undefined) clarification = await this.maybeClarify(userText)`; Session.maybeClarify() (runs CLARIFY_SYSTEM via Session.runInference with maxTokens 2000, fail-open try/catch); Session.askQuestionRound(); Session.buildClarifySkim() / peekWorkspaceOverview(); parseClarifyVerdict(), parseQuestionArray(), salvageQuestionObjects(); constants CLARIFY_SYSTEM, CLARIFY_MAX_QUESTIONS (3), CLARIFY_SKIM_MAX_CHARS.

TEST CHECKLIST
1. With settings.clarify true and a FakeProvider whose first scripted turn returns text '{"clarify":true,"questions":[{"question":"Which genre?","header":"Genre","options":[{"label":"Platformer","description":""},{"label":"Puzzle","description":""}]}]}', the askUser stub is called once with one question before any main-loop request, and the first main request's user message contains 'Clarify pre-layer' and the chosen answer.
2. The first FakeProvider request is the clarify side-call: its system prompt is the CLARIFY_SYSTEM text and its messages contain 'Incoming request:' followed by the user text; the second request is the real turn.
3. When the scripted clarify reply is '{"clarify":false}', askUser is never called and the real turn runs with exactly the plain user text.
4. When the clarify side-call throws (FakeTurn with error) or returns garbage text, askUser is never called and the turn still runs to turn_finished (fail-open).
5. With settings.clarify false, or on a child session (child:true), or when the user text names an installed addon, no clarify request is made: the FakeProvider's first request is the main turn.
6. A scripted reply with five questions results in askUser receiving at most CLARIFY_MAX_QUESTIONS (3) questions.
